atoms.name: Centring and covariance matrix
atoms.one_line: $\Sigma=\frac1{n-1}X_c^\top X_c$; divisor changes eigenvalues, not directions or ratios.

atoms.name: Eigenvectors and eigenvalues as PCs
atoms.one_line: PC $k$ is the $k$-th eigenvector; variance along it is $\lambda_k$; PCs are orthogonal.

atoms.name: Projection and reconstruction
atoms.one_line: Score $z=u^\top(x-\mu)$; $\hat x=\mu+zu$; error is the discarded variance.

atoms.name: Properties and edge cases
atoms.one_line: Spherical data: any orthonormal basis; scale-sensitive; rank $\le\min(n-1,d)$; scores uncorrelated.

atoms.name: What PCA is and is not
atoms.one_line: Unsupervised, linear dimensionality reduction; optimal reconstruction; labels ignored.
